clues.text: While shepherding Jethro's flock, Moses led it to the far side of the wilderness and came to this mountain of God.
When the thirsty Israelites grumbled, God told Moses to strike the rock at this place so water would pour out.
Strengthened by bread and water from an angel, Elijah walked forty days and forty nights to reach this mountain of God.
A psalm recalls that at this place the Israelites made a calf and worshiped a molten image.
Moses reminded Israel that here God spoke to them out of the fire, and they saw no form at all.
Moses noted that the journey from this place to Kadesh-barnea by way of Mount Seir took eleven days.
When Solomon's priests set the ark in the temple, it held only the two stone tablets Moses placed in it here.

taken: Moses was tending this man's flock on the far side of the wilderness when he came to Horeb.
